description: KSel-2 (bean qou-mee2; audit-only, scope-(a), NO FIT, nothing wired): GNS/spectral-measure route to binding-kernel canonicity, via Favard/Jacobi. K1-K2: the two canonical moment functionals — the balanced kernel moments m_k = q^(-k(k-1)/4)[k]_q! and the Lean-proved C1 carrier numerators S_q(n) — each determine a UNIQUE Jacobi matrix; the carrier data has the verified-range closed form alpha_k = q^k, beta_k = q^(k-1)[k]_q (a q-deformed Gaussian N(1,1)); the kernel data has beta_1 = q^(1/2)+q^(-1/2)-1 = 1+(r-1/r)^2 — exact SOS positivity, the Wenzl quantity. K3-K4: Favard positivity (Hankel + beta > 0) EXACT at r=21/20 and q=6/5, 60-dps at both q0 pins; monic-Jacobi moment reproduction (M^n)_00 = m_n exact — the canonical positive operator EXISTS with the binding data as moments, in both frames, Stieltjes-supported in the kernel frame. K5: at q = 1 both frames are Carleman-determinate (Laguerre alpha=2k+1, beta=k^2; Gaussian alpha=1, beta=k, exact) — the canonical kernel e^(-s)ds is DERIVED, zero convention. K3/K6-K7: at q != 1 beta grows geometrically (Carleman unavailable) and the theta-translate reindex identity (exact) gives a continuum of representing measures — the moment problem is INDETERMINATE, the minimal Jacobi operator has deficiency (1,1), and the kernel choice REAPPEARS as the self-adjoint-extension circle. Verdict: PARTIAL — the operator is canonical and derived, the measure is not; the remaining identification is the extension choice (Friedrichs/Krein distinguished; audit doc section 5). Nothing here proves or refutes any conjecture.
